_about: The rig on this machine, for tools/bench (tasks/RUNBOOK.md section 2). Copy to bench.local.json - git-ignored - and fill in the RAK's USB serial number: Device Manager > the port > Details > Parent (the 16 hex digits after the last backslash), or `python -m serial.tools.list_ports -v`. tools/bench/config.py says what every field means.
